subject: Temporal handoff: demo time mismatch across EU/US/APAC

From: Lukas Müller <lukas.muller@brightretail.de>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: BrightRetail Demo Team <demo@brightretail.de>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed time (CEST)

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick responses. Can we confirm Tuesday 18 Aug 10:00 CEST for a 45-minute demo? That time works for our regional product lead and Anna in Frankfurt. I've attached the calendar invite (ICS).

Proposed agenda:
- 10m intro & goals
- 20m walkthrough (models, latency, deployment options)
- 10m pricing/next steps
- 5m Q&A

If there's a conflict with US stakeholder hours, we can shift by an hour either side.

Best,
Lukas Müller
Head of Partnerships — BrightRetail

On Mon, 17 Aug 2026 at 14:03 Lukas Müller <lukas.muller@brightretail.de> wrote:
> Hi Soojin / Karthik,
> 
> Thanks for the quick responses. Can we confirm Tuesday 18 Aug 10:00 CEST for a 45-minute demo?

Thanks, Lukas — we appreciate the flexibility. Quick note: Karthik is traveling to San Francisco and will be in a travel blackout from 18 Aug 16:00 CEST through 19 Aug 06:00 CEST. That maps to roughly midday US Pacific. Vanessa is in the US (PDT) and has a hard constraint between 09:00–11:30 PDT on the 18th.

I think the stuck point is that 10:00 CEST is 01:00 PDT — which won't work for Vanessa or our US-based stakeholders. Do you have any availability later in the day CEST (e.g., 16:00–17:00 CEST) so it lands in the morning for PDT? Alternatively, we can move to Wednesday 19 Aug morning CEST.

Apologies for the churn — this is a bit of a temporal handoff across regions.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the heads up, Soojin. Apologies — our schedules were set by colleagues in Frankfurt and we didn't translate the CEST/PDT mapping correctly. 16:00 CEST (18 Aug) would be 07:00 PDT — still a bit early for Vanessa, but potentially doable if she can start early. However, Anna flagged that 16:00 CEST clashes with an internal ops window at BrightRetail (30-minute maintenance).

Could we try: 18 Aug at 18:00 CEST (which is 09:00 PDT) — that should be within Vanessa's window and after your team's travel blackout. If that still conflicts, Wednesday 19 Aug 10:00 CEST (01:00 PDT) would be too late for US, sorry — scratch that.

I can do 18 Aug 18:00 CEST. Anna, can you confirm?

Best,
Lukas

9:00 PDT works for me if we keep it tight at 40–45 minutes. Karthik — I saw your travel note; if you can dial in early on your flight that's fine, but if not we can record. Soojin — please share the updated invite so timezone labels are explicit (CEST vs CEST+DST symbolic confusions have bitten us before). I exported a quick screenshot of the conversion table attached — shows the mapping to PDT/BRT etc.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
